reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Crystals inside volcanoes can preserve signals that help researchers understand approaching eruptions.
An ancient Arabian lakeshore provides evidence of human life in a landscape once much greener than today.
An unusual pair of stars helps explain a repeating radio signal from a dead star.
Chemical evidence in ancient rocks helps scientists date the beginnings of plate tectonics.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: One idea was that they were extremely slow-spinning neutron star pulsars, the collapsed cores of enormous stars which also send out repeating radio flashes.

questions.prompt: What distinguishes the newly reported source of repeating radio signals?
options: The signal comes from an artificial satellite.
The researchers ruled out white dwarfs entirely.
No star is involved in producing it.
A white dwarf is paired with a Sun-like star.
questions.explanation: 第 4 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: In new research published today in Nature Astronomy, we report the first discovery of a different source for one of these enigmatic intermittent broadcasters: it still involves a white dwarf, but also a star much like our own Sun.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 11?
options: The pulses only appear during a window of about six hours, followed by 26 hours without pulses.
And if we can find these objects around many different types of stars, it will give us insights into the lives and deaths of stars like our own Sun, across our galaxy and beyond.
With the next generation of radio telescopes, such as the SKA Observatory, we expect to find many more.
In late 2024, we were looking for new long-period transients using the Murchison Widefield Array radio telescope in Western Australia.
questions.explanation: 定位第 11 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: In late 2024, we were looking for new long-period transients using the Murchison Widefield Array radio telescope in Western Australia.
